Name: Fire
Notes: A player counts as Fire if their Element column says Fire - OR if they drank something whose Element column says Fire. See Brews.csv. This is the one to copy when you add a new element

Name: Water
Notes: Cold and patient. The healing and reviving side of the table

Name: Wand
Notes: The Brandteufel set is all Wand out of the box - so a pure Brandteufel side fills this bar and nothing else

Name: Brandteufel
Notes: From = class, so it follows the BREWED class. A Lorelei who drank a Fire Brew counts as a Brandteufel here, which is the whole point of brewing

Name: Lorelei
Notes: The mirror of the row above

Name: Star
Notes: From = star, so the Value column is ignored. Only Player Type = Star counts. You hold one Star in Adventure, so 2 is hard - it needs the cycle to come round

Name: Journeyman
Notes: THE STARTER TEAM. BasicTeam.csv has Unit Type = Normal and Element = None, so without this row those players would put nothing on the pile at all and the bar would never move for them. A player whose element and class match no row here simply contributes nothing - which is a legal thing to want, but it should be on purpose

Name: The Rivals
Notes: The scratch side. Here so that a Rivals player is not iconless either
